provenance.originStatement: All selected source snapshots date from 2021 or 2022. The collections invite joke contributions or explicitly describe community-contributed material, except petershank/jokes, which describes itself simply as a collection of jokes. Historical publication is evidence against newly generated filler, not independent proof of each joke's original author or a guarantee of human authorship. Repository licences are the stated basis for reuse; no unsupported individual author attribution is made.
provenance.reviewScope: Preserved all 202 original curated items exactly, including their IDs and citations. All newly included complete setups and punchlines or whole one-liners were read individually. Selected clean, coherent broad adult humour; excluded explicit, sexual, degrading, gory, violent, suicide, racist, religious or political targeting and unsuitable or incomplete entries. Secular holiday references, mild bathroom humour, nonviolent fictional crime puns and familiar fictional characters may occur. Original wording, spelling, punctuation and whitespace are retained. One-liners retain their full text as prompt without an invented answer. For petershank, literal Q:/A: field labels and separate date annotations are not joke text and are omitted. Knock-knock dialogue uses the source's existing final answer line without rewriting. Normalized setup, whole-joke and punchline uniqueness was mechanically checked; likely near-duplicate variants were reviewed manually.
provenance.targetCaveat: The reviewed, appropriately licensed historical sources did not yield 1000 distinct suitable jokes. The bank was not padded with generated, unlicensed, repeated or weaker material. See credits for the precise research frontier and excluded source candidates.
